name: Sakawa (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Sakawa town emblem in white: a crown-like device above a ring of concentric arcs.
history: Municipal flag of Sakawa, a town in Kōchi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 5 January 1972.

features.role: Sakawa town emblem — a crown-like device above a ring of concentric arcs
